Drop element writes nothing for an inline data image

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import ConversionOptions, InlineDataMedia, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p>Before <img src="data:image/png;base64,AAAA" alt="icon"> after</p>'
    options = ConversionOptions(inline_data_media=InlineDataMedia("DropElement"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
